title: Stan Meyer collection group killed
place_text: Michigan; United Kingdom; Orange County, California

tellings.quote: Stan Meyer guys, you know who those guys who got the Stan Meyer collection and that Toroid, all of them but one were killed.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, talks about Stan Meyer, an inventor who worked on energy from water. Greer says that the men who got hold of Meyer's collection of work, including a ring-shaped device called a toroid, were all killed except one, which he says he heard from an unnamed British lord. He tells it as a sign that someone is willing to kill to keep such inventions buried.
